Excellent — 20000 random worker problems, all certificates pass, max solve time 3ms.

Now let me stress with larger problems (more commodities and slots). Let me modify the generator to make bigger problems: ncom up to 24, slots up to 8, and larger graphs.

Let me create a variant with bigger sizes.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tests && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='stress_worker.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("    nodes = rng.randint(2, 8)","    nodes = rng.randint(2, 20) if BIG else rng.randint(2, 8)")
s=s.replace("    nE = rng.randint(1, 20)","    nE = rng.randint(1, 64) if BIG else rng.randint(1, 20)")
s=s.replace("    ncom = rng.randint(0, 10)","    ncom = rng.randint(0, 24) if BIG else rng.randint(0, 10)")
s=s.replace("        for _ in range(rng.randint(0, 6)):","        for _ in range(rng.randint(0, 8) if BIG else rng.randint(0, 6)):")
s=s.replace("def main(seed0, N):","BIG = False\n\n\ndef main(seed0, N):")
s=s.replace("    rng = random.Random(seed0)\n    bad = 0","    global BIG\n    BIG = len(sys.argv) > 3 and sys.argv[3] == 'big'\n    rng = random.Random(seed0)\n    bad = 0")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
cd /workspace && OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native PYTHONPATH=/workspace/.deps:/workspace/submission:/workspace/tests timeout 170 python3 tests/stress_worker.py 200000 3000 big
